annotations.title: App Store listing and its changes

description: An app's App Store listing (name, icon, developer, version, genre, price, rating) and every change Apptiller has seen to it: name, icon, description, screenshots, version and release notes, price. Checked daily; set refresh to look it up now. Uses Apple's public lookup, so it needs only the App Store id or bundle id, no App Store Connect access.

country.description: Storefront, e.g. US (default: the one used before, else US).

days.description: How far back to list changes.

refresh.description: Look the listing up now instead of showing the last daily check.

name: app_store_listing
title: App Store listing and its changes
